name: native-source-inventory
goal: Reject empty native source inventories and resolve metadata-backed Git paths from the selected repository root

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: 7ad0dac9b standard native scenario ran 78 simulator assertions but failed the added nonempty source assertion: metadata Git commands inherited Desktop cwd and matched no source paths.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: ios-acceptance-guards tested refusals but omitted a valid metadata-backed inventory from Desktop cwd. Extend that normal matrix with all three actual source inventories and retain the positive scenario assertion.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed failing source 9340358c6, record 63a83dc4: valid selected metadata yields zero source files from Desktop cwd.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Keep selected metadata and worktree explicit, and set Git cwd to the repository root. Reject empty inventories before native builds; normal guard and simulator scenario assert all three source sets.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Git now resolves path filters from the selected repository root; readSources refuses any empty renderer, shell or fixture inventory before a native build.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged six-case guard corpus: sealed d0cc50cc red and 771c4552 green at 1bc96a09d. All actual source inventories are nonempty.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated reintroduction of 9340358c6 failed again, record affbca22; restored 1bc96a09d passed, record e3f8399f. Same six-case corpus, commands and selected-object context.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
